copyAlignment.source_first: Place source mower {{source}} in front of its own dock with the camera pattern visible. Do not dock. Let the mower stop completely, then measure.
copyAlignment.source_second: Move {{source}} about 20 cm while keeping the same dock pattern visible. Stop and measure again to check repeatability.
copyAlignment.target_first: Move {{source}} clear. Drive target mower {{target}} in front of {{source}}’s dock with the same pattern visible. Do not dock. Stop and measure.
copyAlignment.target_second: Move {{target}} about 20 cm in front of that same dock of {{source}}. Keep the pattern visible, stop and measure again.
copyAlignment.ready: Measurements are complete. Return {{target}} to its OWN dock with charging contact. Then check the preview and apply the copy.

map.copyAlignmentManual: Drive the mowers yourself with the existing joystick. This wizard sends no movement commands.
map.copyAlignmentConfirm: I confirm the mower is viewing the physical dock of {{source}}. The pattern alone does not identify the station.
map.copyAlignmentTestNotice: Test feature: camera accuracy still requires validation on the devices. Missing or unreliable measurements block copying.

map.droneHint: Drag the photo until it lines up; rotation and width pivot on the charging station when it lies in the photo. It is a tracing aid only; the mower never uses it.
map.dronePointFirst: Click the charging station in the photo.
map.dronePointPhoto: Click a recognisable spot in the photo: an obstacle, a corner of the patio, a drain.
map.dronePointMap: Now click on the map where that point really is.
map.dronePointsInfo: Two or three points: shift, rotate and scale. From four on, a photo taken at an angle is straightened too. Pick them far apart.
map.droneRestoreHint: Puts the photo back; nothing is kept until you save.
map.droneFromPhoto: First placement from the photo itself: the drone's GPS, height and heading.
map.droneOblique: The camera looked {{deg}}° below the horizon, not straight down. Use four or more points.
map.droneResidualInfo: Deviation: how far that photo point still is from its map point. With 2 or 4 points it is always 0; with more you see how well the photo fits as a whole. A large number is usually a misclicked point, or a roof or treetop.
map.dronePointsSliders: While picking, the points define the placement; the sliders work again afterwards.

ai.title: AI Perception
ai.desc: Camera AI model and navigation behavior
ai.tipSegmentation: Semantic segmentation — classifies each pixel as lawn, road, obstacle, etc. Default mode for normal mowing.
ai.tipDetection: Object detection — detects people, animals, shoes, rocks and other objects. Best for safety-critical situations.
ai.tipSegHigh: High sensitivity segmentation — more cautious, avoids more areas. Use on complex lawns with many obstacles.
ai.tipSegLow: Low sensitivity segmentation — less cautious, mows closer to edges. Use on simple, open lawns.
ai.tipLawnCover: Stay on lawn only — treats non-lawn surfaces (paths, gravel) as obstacles. Default for normal mowing.
ai.tipFreeMove: Free navigation — ignores lawn boundaries, drives over paths and other surfaces. Useful for crossing driveways.
ai.tipBoundaryFollow: Follow lawn boundary edges — mows along the detected lawn border. Good for edge trimming.

cert.title: Install certificate
cert.intro: The Novabot app uses HTTPS. Install the local CA certificate so the app can connect.
cert.macTitle: Mac (including the iOS app on Apple Silicon)

mac.s1: Download opennova-ca.crt and double-click it → Keychain Access opens
mac.s2: The cert is now in the System keychain but is NOT trusted yet
mac.s3: Double-click "OpenNova Local CA" in the list
mac.s5: Set "When using this certificate" to "Always Trust"
mac.s6: Close the window → enter your Mac password when asked

iphone.s1: Send the .crt file to your iPhone (AirDrop or email)
iphone.s3: Go to Settings → Profile Downloaded → Install
iphone.s4: Go to Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings

iphoneStrict.s1: Send the .crt file to your iPhone (AirDrop or email)
iphoneStrict.s2: Tap the file → "Profile Downloaded" appears at the top
iphoneStrict.s3: Go to Settings → "Profile Downloaded" at the top → Install → Install
iphoneStrict.s4: ⚠️ REQUIRED EXTRA STEP: Go to Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings
iphoneStrict.s5: Turn on the switch for "OpenNova Local CA" → Continue
iphoneStrict.s6: Without this step the certificate does not work!

androidSend.s1: Send opennova-ca.crt to your Android device
androidSend.s2: Go to Settings → Security → Install certificates
androidSend.s3: Choose "CA certificate" and select the file

androidDownload.s1: Download opennova-ca.crt on your Android device
androidDownload.s2: Go to Settings → Security → Install certificates
androidDownload.s3: Choose "CA certificate" and select the file

cert.autoDetectHint: The dashboard continues on its own as soon as the certificate is trusted.
cert.notTrusted: Certificate not trusted yet. Install it and try again.
cert.notTrustedIphone: Certificate not trusted yet. On iPhone: check that you turned on the switch under Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings.

render3d.title: Your garden as a 3D AI render
render3d.body: Turn your garden into a 3D render, top-down or angled, by day or in the evening. Your zones, obstacles and the mower appear on it live. Pick it under Base layer in the map toolbar. Note: the render is drawn by AI from the aerial photo, so it looks like your garden but does not match reality in every detail.
